  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Service" name="Subscription service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Signup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_ActiveSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Cancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Settled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Signup" name="Signup information received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ActiveSubscription" name="Maintain active subscription until cancellation">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ActiveSubscription">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ActiveService" name="Subscription service">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ActiveSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MaintenanceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BillingCycles</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MaintenanceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ActiveSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ActiveSubscription" name="Begin active subscription"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MaintenanceSplit" name="Run subscription activities"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_BillingCycles" name="Run automated billing cycles">
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="true">
          <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">subscriptionActive</bpmn:loopCondition>
        </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications" messageRef="Message_Updates">
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="true">
          <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">subscriptionActive</bpmn:loopCondition>
        </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MaintenanceJoin" name="Complete subscription activities"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ActiveSubscription" name="Active subscription phase ends"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActiveStart_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_MaintenanceSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Billing" sourceRef="Gateway_MaintenanceSplit" targetRef="Task_BillingCycles"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_MaintenanceSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Billing_Join" sourceRef="Task_BillingCycles" targetRef="Gateway_MaintenanceJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_MaintenanceJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ActiveEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MaintenanceJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ActiveSubscription"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request received" attachedToRef="SubProcess_ActiveSubscription" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Support team processes cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsSplit" name="Apply adjustments required by terms" default="Flow_Terms_None"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsJoin" name="Complete applicable adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Support team deactivates subscription"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Settled" name="Subscription deactivated and final account balance settled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signup_Generate" sourceRef="StartEvent_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_Assign" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Active" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="SubProcess_ActiveSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Active_Cancellation" sourceRef="SubProcess_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Boundary_Cancellation" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Cancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Process_Terms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_TermsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Refund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundDue</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Charge" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">chargeDue</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_None" name="No refund or charge applies" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_TermsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Join" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge_Join" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Deactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsJoin" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deactivate_Settle" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Settle_End" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Settled"/>
  </bpmn:process>

rules.instruction: When the description identifies an ongoing process phase that is followed by a stated activity or outcome: Model the phase so that its sequence flow continues to the subsequent activity or outcome, using a gateway if the described control flow requires a decision or synchronization.
rules.situation: the description identifies an ongoing process phase that is followed by a stated activity or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description indicates that an activity recurs at intervals during a longer-running process phase.: Model the recurring activity as work within that phase and connect it to the surrounding process flow.
rules.situation: the description indicates that an activity recurs at intervals during a longer-running process phase.

rules.instruction: When the description assigns an action to a particular participant or distinguishes that action from related actions: label each corresponding BPMN element with the described action and responsible participant; do not substitute another actor or conflate it with a separate action
rules.situation: the description assigns an action to a particular participant or distinguishes that action from related actions

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the described action as an activity after that event; do not use the start event alone to represent the action.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action, such as providing information or submitting a request

rules.instruction: When the description states an order among process stages, describes branches that converge, or says that multiple required activities must finish before a later stage or process completion: Model the sequence flows that connect the corresponding elements, preserving the stated order and branch-and-join structure. Use gateway types that match whether the description specifies a choice or requires all branches to complete.
rules.situation: the description states an order among activities, describes conditional paths, or indicates that multiple activities must occur before a later stage or outcome
